title: One after the other
story: ProteinMPNN (mpnn.sh) needs the backbones that RFdiffusion (rfd.sh) makes. Submit rfd.sh, then submit mpnn.sh so that it only starts after rfd.sh finishes successfully.

lesson.title: Waiting for another job

parts.note: ...but don't start until job 48215 finishes successfully. Use the job ID `sbatch` printed for the first job.

lesson.why: You can queue a whole pipeline at once, and each step only takes a GPU when its inputs exist.
lesson.without: Both jobs start together, and the second finds no backbones to work on. If the first job fails, an `afterok` job never starts (reason DependencyNeverSatisfied).

files.~/{{project}}/rfd.sh:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=rfd
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%j.out

module load anaconda
conda activate rfdiffusion
python /opt/RFdiffusion/scripts/run_inference.py inference.output_prefix=outputs/bb 'contigmap.contigs=[A1-150/0 70-100]' inference.num_designs=10
files.~/{{project}}/mpnn.sh:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=mpnn
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%j.out

module load anaconda
conda activate proteinmpnn

python /opt/ProteinMPNN/protein_mpnn_run.py \
  --pdb_path inputs/target.pdb \
  --out_folder outputs/

tasks.text: Submit mpnn.sh to start after rfd.sh succeeds

hints: `sbatch --dependency=afterok:JOBID mpnn.sh` waits for job JOBID to finish without errors. sbatch printed the ID.
